Remarks

This class is used for manipulating and analyzing sets of points in 2D space, including operations such as finding closest points, transforming, and interpolating between points.

DrawVertices(float, ColorRgba, float)

Draws a circle at each vertex in this collection using the provided radius, color and smoothness.

public void DrawVertices(float vertexRadius, ColorRgba color, float smoothness)

Parameters

vertexRadius float

Radius of the drawn circle for each vertex (in world units).

color ColorRgba

Color of the vertex circles.

smoothness float

The smoothness value (0-1). This controls the visual quality of the circle by inversely interpolating the current CircleSideLengthRange. A value of 0 uses the maximum side length (fewer sides, less smooth), while 1 uses the minimum side length (more sides, smoother). The resulting side length determines the number of polygon sides used to approximate the circle.

GetInterpolatedEdgePoints(float, Points)

Computes one interpolated point along each edge of the closed point loop and writes the results into result.

public void GetInterpolatedEdgePoints(float t, Points result)

Parameters

t float

The interpolation factor used for each edge. Values between 0 and 1 produce points between each vertex and the next vertex.

result Points

The destination collection that will be cleared and populated with the interpolated points.

Remarks

The last point is interpolated toward the first point, so the input is treated as a closed shape. If the collection contains fewer than two points, the method returns without modifying result.

GetInterpolatedEdgePoints(float, int, Points)

Repeatedly computes interpolated edge points for the closed point loop and writes the final result into result.

public void GetInterpolatedEdgePoints(float t, int steps, Points result)

Parameters

t float

The interpolation factor used for each edge on every pass. Values between 0 and 1 produce points between each vertex and the next vertex.

steps int

The number of interpolation passes to perform. Values less than or equal to 1 perform a single pass.

result Points

The destination collection that will receive the interpolated points.

Remarks

The last point is interpolated toward the first point on each pass, so the input is treated as a closed shape. If the collection contains fewer than two points, the method returns without modifying result.

ProjectShape(Polygon, Vector2, bool)

Projects the points along the given vector and writes the convex hull of the combined point set into result.

public bool ProjectShape(Polygon result, Vector2 v, bool useBuffer = false)

Parameters

result Polygon

The destination polygon that receives the convex hull of the original and projected points.

v Vector2

The vector used to offset each projected point.

useBuffer bool

true to reuse the internal points buffer and avoid a temporary allocation; false to allocate a new temporary buffer. Set this to false when calling from parallel or multi-threaded code, since the internal buffer is shared and not thread-safe.

Returns

bool

true if v is non-zero, the collection contains at least two points, and result was populated; otherwise, false.

Remarks

This method creates a temporary doubled point set containing each original point and its translated counterpart, then computes the convex hull into result.
